description: Defines the Administrator class for managing RPC proxies, stubs, channels, and related resources in the Thunder-712 project. Includes nested classes, method declarations, and interface management logic.

classes.name: Administrator
classes.description: Manages RPC proxies, stubs, channels, and interface registration for inter-process communication.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatchable job for handling IPC messages.

classes.name: InvokeServer
classes.description: Implements the IIPCServer interface, managing message dispatch with thread pooling.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of Administrator.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Applies a given action to all registered proxies and dangling proxies.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Registers interface stub and proxy types for a given interface.

methods.name: Recall
methods.description: Unregisters interface stub and proxy types for a given interface.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Creates and returns a new InvokeMessage proxy.

methods.name: DeleteChannel
methods.description: Deletes a communication channel and handles pending proxies.

methods.name: ProxyFind
methods.description: Finds a proxy instance for a given interface and implementation ID.

methods.name: ProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy instance for a given interface.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if a proxy for a given interface and implementation ID is valid.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments reference count for a proxy object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a proxy object or handles release in stub environment.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Dispatches an IPC message through the administrator.

methods.name: RegisterInterface
methods.description: Registers an interface implementation with the IPC channel.

methods.name: UnregisterInterface
methods.description: Unregisters an interface implementation from the IPC channel.
